validityBehavior.description: Interior doors must connect two floor tiles on opposite sides. Exterior doors on the outside boundary of the map may connect to only one interior floor tile.

connectivityBehavior.description: Every room must be reachable from every other room through the interior floorplan using floor tiles and valid interior doors. Exterior doors may exist, but they do not satisfy room-to-room connectivity by themselves. A room may have only one interior connection, but it cannot be isolated behind only exterior doors.

collapseBehavior.description: When a shared wall is created by collapsing adjacent room walls, any multiple door locations on that collapsed wall should resolve into one shared door location. Do not leave adjacent or duplicate doors on the same collapsed wall segment.

description: Doors are created by replacing non-corner wall tiles with door tiles. Every room must have at least one door. Interior doors must connect floor to floor. Exterior doors may have one interior floor side. Doors must not open directly into walls. Every room must be reachable through the interior floorplan; exterior-only access is not enough. When walls collapse into one shared wall, multiple doors on that shared wall collapse into one door location.
